requirements.text: Implement the smallest deterministic prospective T6 ROTATION_SURVIVAL_FORWARD row producer and validator that freezes first-cross baseline, sequence start and available ETHBTC/breadth/BTC.D/deployment/flow states before outcomes, then measures survival, delay cost, failure outcome and exit-side outcome as evidence matures. Preserve missingness and right censoring. Do not invent missing axes, thresholds or portfolio actions.

An eligible first-cross event freezes one immutable sequence source row before outcome evidence, including sequence_id, sequence_start_utc, explicit available/missing axis states and right_censored=true.

Subsequent observations update survival through append-only observations or immutable sidecars and can later compute delay_cost versus the frozen FIRST_ETHBTC_CROSS baseline without rewriting the initial row.
A failed/reversed sequence records failure_outcome and exit_side_outcome only from source-bound post-freeze evidence.
Missing breadth, BTC.D, deployment or flow remains explicit missingness and cannot be inferred or counted as confirmation.
No historical proxy percentage is promoted into a live threshold and cadence-only operational triggers cannot become market rules.
No row or outcome may be created retrospectively after observing the result, and no automatic portfolio action or phase promotion is allowed.

market gates | model weights | canonical authority | portfolio logic | API budget | new policy semantics | new market engine | new live threshold | historical pseudo-row backfill | automatic phase promotion

evidence: PR #841 merged at bc303dc6979d2cb40dbc3acadbaa364d9de8094a after 14 relevant PR gates passed, including Continuity Learning, Experiment Lifecycle, Full Architecture 1-7, Data Architecture, Storage Health and Automation Production Health.

tests/learning/test_t6_rotation_survival.py proves first-cross baseline immutability, explicit missing-axis preservation, no retrospective cross without prior delta, append-only active-sequence observations, no manufactured reversal outcome and non-binding cadence authority.
Fresh main contains four natural ROTATION_SURVIVAL_OBSERVATION_v1 rows dated 2026-09-14, 2026-09-15, 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24, exceeding the required three natural observations.

All four natural rows have retrospective_creation=false. Every available ETHBTC, breadth, BTC.D, deployment and flow axis in those rows is recorded with inferred=false; missing axes remain explicit when absent.

The 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 rows were emitted by integrated Framework Learning Operations after the implementation was already on main, providing prospective production evidence rather than backfilled pseudo-rows.
No T6 artifact grants binding market interpretation, market threshold changes, model-weight changes, portfolio action or state-change authority.
